resources.string: Held separately and privately, on Ethereum through Railgun.
Dollars held privately on Ethereum, in Railgun
Railgun screens new funds before they can be spent. This takes %1$s.

Railgun\'s screening refused these funds, so they can\'t be spent or sent. They can only go back to where they came from, the conversion contract. Contact Zapp support and we\'ll help you get them back.
A send is being confirmed. These funds are available again once it settles.
Loading your private balance. The first time reads Railgun\'s history and can take up to a minute.
Couldn\'t update the balance. Showing the last known amounts.
Convert ZEC into dollars nobody else can see: not your balance, and not who you pay.
Sending and withdrawing are coming soon.
Convert ZEC into dollars. They land in your private balance, held on Ethereum through Railgun.
Railgun screens new funds for %1$s before they can be spent.
Send them privately to a Railgun address, or withdraw them to an Ethereum address.
Nobody else can see your balance, or who you pay.
Amounts show in the currency you picked under You, at today\'s rate.
Your conversions, sends and withdrawals will show here.
Not enough ZEC. You have %1$s available.
The market maker can\'t be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
The relayer that completes conversions can\'t be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
Couldn\'t get a quote. Try again in a moment.
Enter the dollars you want. The market maker quotes a price in ZEC that holds for a few minutes.
Your ZEC goes to a deposit address that you and the market maker control together.
Once the deposit is confirmed, Zapp claims the dollars into your private balance.
Either the dollars reach your private balance, or your ZEC comes back to you.
Takes %1$s. You can leave the app: Zapp keeps going and lets you know when it\'s done.
You pay the ZEC deposit, plus the Zcash network fee.
You receive the dollars left after the relayer\'s fee and Railgun\'s 0.25%% fee for shielding them.
The quote holds for a few minutes. If it runs out, get a new one: nothing is sent until you convert.
This quote ran out. Get a new one to continue.
The conversion couldn\'t start. Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
The market maker hasn\'t confirmed your deposit yet. If it still hasn\'t by %1$s, Zapp claims your dollars by itself.
The market maker hasn\'t opened the swap yet. Nothing has been sent.
Your ZEC payment didn\'t finish in time. The market maker will call the swap off shortly, and any ZEC that left comes back to you.
Picking up where it left off.
The swap was called off. Zapp is bringing your ZEC back to your wallet.
You can leave this screen. Zapp keeps going in the background and lets you know when it\'s done.
The market maker opens the swap on Ethereum and locks the dollars in it.
Zapp sends your ZEC to the deposit address you and the market maker share.
The market maker waits for %1$d Zcash confirmations.
Zapp claims the dollars into your private balance. A relayer pays the Ethereum fees.
Railgun screens them for %1$s before they can be spent.
If the swap can\'t finish in time, it\'s called off and your ZEC comes back, less a small network fee.
Zapp can\'t reach the relayer that sends your claim. It keeps trying by itself.
Zapp can\'t reach the market maker. It keeps trying by itself.
Zapp can\'t reach Ethereum right now. It keeps trying by itself.
Railgun isn\'t accepting deposits right now, so Zapp holds off claiming. If it doesn\'t reopen in time, the swap is called off and your ZEC comes back.
The market maker holds the claim for a few minutes. Zapp claims as soon as it\'s your turn.
Your Zcash wallet isn\'t ready. Zapp retries once it has synced.
Something went wrong. Zapp keeps trying by itself.
%1$s is in your private balance. Railgun screens new funds for %2$s before they can be spent.
%1$s is in your private balance, ready to use.
The market maker called the swap off, so your ZEC came back to your wallet, less a small network fee.
The swap couldn\'t be completed in time, so it was called off and your ZEC came back, less a small network fee.
The quote ran out before the market maker took it. Your ZEC never left your wallet.
The market maker turned the conversion down. Your ZEC never left your wallet.
The market maker isn\'t taking conversions right now. Your ZEC never left your wallet.
The swap never opened on Ethereum. Your ZEC never left your wallet.
The swap on Ethereum didn\'t match its quote, so Zapp didn\'t send your ZEC.
The swap opened too late to finish safely, so Zapp didn\'t send your ZEC.
The market maker called the swap off before your ZEC was sent. Your ZEC never left your wallet.
Shows while a conversion is running.
Tells you when a conversion finishes or needs you.
Zapp is working in the background
Your dollars are in your private balance.
The conversion was called off and your ZEC is back in your wallet.
Nothing was sent. Your ZEC is still in your wallet.
Open Zapp so it can finish converting to private USD.
Anyone on Ethereum can see this amount and address.
Enter the amount and the recipient\'s Railgun address, which starts with 0zk.
Your phone builds a zero-knowledge proof. This takes a few seconds.
The dollars move inside Railgun: nobody else sees the amount, or who sent and received it.
Enter the amount and an Ethereum address, which starts with 0x.
Your phone builds a proof, and the dollars leave Railgun for that address.
Once withdrawn, the amount and the address are visible to anyone on Ethereum.
To stay private, don\'t withdraw the exact amount you just converted, wait a while first, and use a fresh address each time.
Railgun keeps 0.25%% of what you withdraw.
Testnet only: a Zapp test account pays for this transaction and sends it, which ties it to that account on Ethereum. Real sends will go through Railgun\'s broadcasters.
Your phone builds a zero-knowledge proof so nobody can see what you send. This takes a few seconds.
The send didn\'t go through, and your balance is unchanged. Try again in a moment.
